findings.title: Translate only lazy-loads current locale, so fallbacks stay unloaded
findings.body: I18n.translate in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb calls load_locale(config.locale) only for the active locale. With the new fallback chain [user locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en], the fallback locales may never have been loaded via I18n.ensure_loaded!. I18n fallback lookup cannot find translations in unloaded files and returns translation-missing even though the yml exists. ApplicationController#set_locale calls I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!, but mailers, background jobs, and any code outside a controller request never do, so those paths get missing translations.

findings.title: Translation LRU cache key ignores fallback chain
findings.body: The cache key in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb is "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}". After this PR the translated value also depends on SiteSetting.default_locale and the content of fallback locales (:en plus site default). A cached hit/miss for a locale is never invalidated when the site default changes or when a fallback locale file is loaded later, so requests can keep serving the wrong language or a stale translation-missing string until I18n.reload! clears the whole cache.

findings.title: Fallback list does not normalize locales and can raise on blank default
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#[] in config/initializers/i18n.rb builds [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact without normalizing locale to a symbol, so string 'en' and symbol :en are not deduped, and if SiteSetting.default_locale is nil or empty string, to_sym raises NoMethodError or produces :"" and breaks every I18n lookup that needs a fallback. It also hits SiteSetting (DB/cache read) on every fallback resolution, i.e. on every missing key, adding overhead to the translation miss path.
